dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire No problems whatsoever voting for a woman. I’m excited to see what Tulsi brings to the table in ‘28. She very well could be the candidate.  Though I would say right now I’ve been extremely impressed with Vivek Ramswamy and I hope he’s the candidate in 28.

@dogecoin_empire Absolutely not. I’ve voted both Red and Blue in my life. I voted red and blue in this vote as well. My vote in this presidential election was based strictly on which party showed what I perceived to be a better economic policy for me ands my family. This time around it was Red.
